entries.name: Acid Chrome
entries.notes: Hard cuts on the beat with a full background swap (black to acid lime), Inter Tight 900 uppercase statements, mono HUD; the chrome object is left out.

entries.name: Airy UI
entries.notes: Off-white canvas, white surfaces with very soft shadows, Inter only, one blue accent and green only for success; cards slide in from the right.

entries.name: Bauhaus Grid
entries.notes: Only cream, red, blue and black with flat fills; Outfit 800 lowercase, an italic Instrument Serif label, per-letter rise with alternating tilt, a full-frame wipe from the bottom.

entries.name: Biennale Yellow
entries.notes: Parchment ground, one indigo ink, solar yellow only as an underprint behind the accent word; hairlines, no shadows, a page number.

entries.name: BlockFrame
entries.notes: 4 px black borders with hard offset shadows, Inter 900 uppercase, the five-pastel candy palette; pushes between moments.

entries.name: Blue Professional
entries.notes: Warm cream canvas, one saturated cobalt, cobalt-tinted cards with no shadows; a cobalt band wipes between moments.

entries.name: Blueprint
entries.notes: Navy with a faint grid, strokes instead of fills, STIX Two Text for display, cyan for the subject and amber for measurements; no cuts, text writes on character by character.

entries.name: Bold Poster
entries.notes: Shrikhand at poster scale against Libre Baskerville, tomato red, double-rule borders; hard cuts with a red flash.

entries.name: Broadside
entries.notes: Massive lowercase Barlow 900 as a graphic primitive, two registers (ink black and fire orange); the card and terminal moments switch to the orange register.

entries.name: Capsule
entries.notes: Pill geometry with a 2 px ink outline on everything, soft hard-offset shadows, Bodoni Moda against Space Grotesk, grain; iris cuts.

entries.name: Cartesian
entries.notes: Warm stone palette, Playfair 400 against Inter, a single taupe hairline as the only structure, compass rings; slow crossfades.

entries.name: Case File
entries.notes: Grey-green paper with grain and vignette, Playfair 900 evidence numbers, typed Courier Prime captions, hard cuts with a slow push; the terminal sits on cork.

entries.name: Cobalt Grid
entries.notes: Cream paper with cobalt as the only ink over permanent graph paper, Newsreader against Hanken Grotesk and DM Mono; pixel-glitch cuts.

entries.name: Code editorial
entries.notes: Warm cream paper, EB Garamond display, Inter body, JetBrains Mono on a warm-navy code surface, a single terracotta coral kept scarce.

entries.name: Control room at night
entries.notes: A control-room launch look: navy ground with a royal-blue and a teal pool, cyan as the one emphasis colour, violet buttons, Archivo Black against Geist. Hero numbers are gold in the original; the strip keeps cyan.

entries.name: Coral
entries.notes: Three surfaces (coral fire, ink black, warm cream), Bebas Neue tracked uppercase, a 45-degree hatch, zero radius; the card and terminal moments sit on the coral region.

entries.name: Cream Serif
entries.notes: Cream ground, Fraunces 800 with one coral italic word per line, headlines resolve from blur, hard cuts; the stat lands with a back-out overshoot.

entries.name: Creative Mode
entries.notes: Cream canvas, 4 px ink borders with hard offset shadows, Archivo Black uppercase at 0.92 line height, JetBrains Mono taxonomy, four accents.

entries.name: Cyanotype Mac
entries.notes: Full-bleed cobalt cyanotype with dither tones, Pixelify Sans and Silkscreen, stepped eases instead of smooth fades, a slow creeping push; the Mac itself is left out and the terminal is a 1-bit screen.

entries.name: Daisy Days
entries.notes: Sunny-garden pastels with charcoal 3 px outlines and hard offset shadows, Fredoka against Quicksand, bouncy letters and iris cuts.

entries.name: Data Drift
entries.notes: Thin weightless Inter, purple and cyan light pools that drift, everything resolves through blur and scale; the particle field is a faint dot grid.

entries.name: Deconstructed
entries.notes: Letters scramble then snap, stepped exits, scan lines and grain; glitch cuts between moments.

entries.name: Dither Serif
entries.notes: White, cobalt and black scenes alternating, DM Serif Display with one handwritten accent word in cobalt, iris cuts; the ordered dithering of the subject is left out.

entries.name: Dot Field
entries.notes: Viewfinder HUD over everything, hard cuts that switch the whole background colour, Archivo Black letters tumbling in, an Instrument Serif italic accent word, a dot field.

entries.name: Dot Matrix
entries.notes: A board of round dots with hot pink captions; the source draws its own 5x7 bitmap letters from divs, here the pixel face Silkscreen stands in, letters pop in with back.out(3), cream and black cut on the scan line.

entries.name: Editorial Forest
entries.notes: Deep green ground, cream type, one pink accent, Source Serif 4 at weight 500 with JetBrains Mono uppercase chrome, flat paper depth with 2 px rules.

entries.name: Folk Frequency
entries.notes: Rounded Fredoka (Fredoka One is now shipped as Fredoka), bouncing letters, bold outlines, iris cuts; the card and terminal sit on a yellow block.

entries.name: Label Collage
entries.notes: Cream paper and indigo night paper cut against each other, Space Mono label-tape type slapping in with back.out(2.2), coral Caveat handwriting for the accent word, grain over everything.

entries.name: Maximalist Type
entries.notes: Anton at poster size, hard cuts with a flash, the project card and terminal land on a yellow colour block.

entries.name: Midnight Glow
entries.notes: Near-black with a faint purple glow at the centre, Inter 600 centred lines that resolve through blur and opacity; no hard cuts.

entries.name: Mono Plex
entries.notes: Black, white and two greys only, IBM Plex Sans statements with IBM Plex Mono labels, a strict left column, fades and a blinking caret.

entries.name: Motion Principles
entries.notes: White and ink-black scenes hard-cut against each other, Inter Tight 900 statements stretched in with an elastic squash, a blue Caveat handwritten accent word, tiny mono labels.

entries.name: Navy Teal
entries.notes: Deep navy, one teal highlight, Space Grotesk throughout; counters via onUpdate, fade-up exits.

entries.name: Neon Terminal
entries.notes: Green phosphor on black with a scanline overlay, JetBrains Mono for everything, typed text, glitch cuts.

entries.name: Noir Quote
entries.notes: Letterbox bars and film grain over near-black, Playfair italic that fades in word by word through blur, nothing faster than a second; the source has no accent colour, so the warm muted tone serves as one.

entries.name: Paper Marker
entries.notes: Warm paper and ink-black cut hard against each other, Archivo Black lines that slam in, a yellow highlighter behind the accent word, Caveat marker notes.

entries.name: Parchment Epic
entries.notes: Parchment plates with grain and a brown vignette, Cinzel uppercase headlines, a persistent HUD, hard cuts between plates; the engraving illustrations are left out.

entries.name: Pop Zine
entries.notes: Cream paper, navy halftone and a slowly rotating pink sunburst, Anton punch words with a hard navy offset shadow, hard cuts every moment, Share Tech Mono stamps.

entries.name: Red Band Title
entries.notes: Charcoal, crimson and off-white, Dela Gothic One letters dropping in with back.out, Oswald tracked sublines, hard cuts with a crimson flash; the card and terminal sit on the cream hit card.

entries.name: Shadow Cut
entries.notes: Near-monochrome with one blood accent, Oswald uppercase, elements emerge from darkness through blur, vignette and grain.

entries.name: Soft Signal
entries.notes: Playfair italic, warm cream, slow word-by-word blur; nothing snaps.

entries.name: Split Flap
entries.notes: Dark wall, black housing with a bezel, amber and green status colours, Barlow Condensed; characters flip in on a stepped rotation and moments re-flip top to bottom.

entries.name: Swiss Pulse
entries.notes: Grid-locked, numbers dominate, hard entrances. Helvetica Neue is not an open font; Inter stands in.

entries.name: Topo Credits
entries.notes: Black with permanent letterbox bars, pale contour rings, one red rule, Cormorant Garamond tracked uppercase that resolves from blur.

entries.name: UI Microstudy
entries.notes: One element on a flat saturated field (purple, then teal for the card and agent moments), white cards with ink text, Inter 800 numbers, letters that rise with back.out, a circular wipe from the centre.

entries.name: Velvet Standard
entries.notes: Thin uppercase Inter, wide tracking, long glides. The indigo accent is dark on black, so the number stays white and the accent is kept to rules and the button.
